roundBasis: Global chronological rounds; district/assembly scopes retain the same global round membership and use their own denominators.

modelAssumptions.absentRecallPolicy: TDP and JSP are absent from the recalled-2023 answer options; their recall share is recorded as zero, not inferred.
modelAssumptions.projection: 2023 actual + (2028 intention share − recalled 2023 share); floor negatives; normalise the seven-party vector to 100%.
modelAssumptions.others: Others is the residual component of the same seven-party vector; raw 2028 answers have no separate Others option.
